headword: {職務内容|しょくむないよう}

definitions.gloss: job duties; job description; scope of work
definitions.explanation: The specific tasks, responsibilities, and functions that make up a particular job or position.

examples.japanese: {職務内容|しょくむないよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{職務内容|しょくむないよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The job duties are described in detail in the job listing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な{職務内容|しょくむないよう}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}した→質問する：05637_shitsumonsuru⟧。
examples.english: I asked about the specific job duties during the interview.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{職務|しょくむ}→職務：13908_shokumu⟧ (duties, responsibilities) and ⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧ (contents, details). Used in formal business and human resources contexts to describe what a job involves. Commonly appears in job postings, employment contracts, and performance evaluations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職務内容|しょくむないよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧: to explain job duties
- {職務内容|しょくむないよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to confirm job duties
- {職務内容|しょくむないよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: change in job duties
- ⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な{職務内容|しょくむないよう}: specific job duties

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {業務内容|ぎょうむないよう}: work content, business operations — broader; can refer to the work of a department or company, not just an individual
- {仕事内容|しごとないよう}: job content — less formal and more conversational
- {職務記述書|しょくむきじゅつしょ}: job description (document) — the formal written document itself
